1.explanation: This script directly reproduces the NO_FCP condition by importing the `TraceOfTab` computed artifact from Lighthouse’s core, then calling it with a trace that is known to be missing the firstContentfulPaint event (the `airhorner_no_fcp.json` fixture).  The call to `TraceOfTab.request()` will reject with an error whose code is `NO_FCP`, exactly matching the extension failure when the page is rendered in the background.
1.bug_scenario: When Lighthouse is run as a Chrome extension against a page that is not in the foreground (i.e. the tab is hidden or backgrounded), the tracing will never fire a "firstContentfulPaint" event.  In the extension UI you see “NO_FCP” and every performance metric fails with the red “Error!” status.
